paragraphs.source_en: On the second day of the seventh month in the fifth year of Keichō, Tokugawa Ieyasu arrived at Edo Castle. On the seventh day of the month, Ieyasu summoned the assembled commanders in Edo to the great hall, honored them with a banquet, and laid out the dispositions for the entire army.

paragraphs.source_en: Could Ieyasu truly be so confident of defeating the Uesugi that he could annihilate them amid laughter and conversation? Yet after finally issuing his dispositions, he declared that he himself would not leave Edo until the twenty-first, leaving everyone utterly perplexed.
